faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering, along with an M.Tech/M.E in Computer Science and Engineering or an equivalent specialization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to complete the application form, attach your bio-data and certificates, and send them to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. GEN/GEN-EWS candidates have a limit of 28 years, OBC-NCL up to 31 years, and SC/ST/PwD/Female candidates up to 33 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application submission, shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview, which can be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q7. Does NIT Warangal offer any experience benefits for this role?
faq.answer: Prior experience in any Research & Development (R&D) laboratory or involvement in relevant academic/industry projects is considered desirable, though not strictly mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based research job, offering an opportunity to work on research and development activities at NIT Warangal.
